description: Stage 4n dedicated cases: control-flow BODY braces carry the block-body statement catalog (StatementShape.OnBracketCreatedEvent -> BlockPossibleShape.OnShellBracketCreated -> TryMountControlFlowBody). Each case asserts, via the shared harness: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte (the harness parses the same source again with StatementRouteUtil.EnableShellExpressions=false); (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape / PossibleShape shell leaks into the shape tree; (5) no file-level fallback. Takeover counters (ControlFlowBodyBraceCount / BlockBodyStatementCount / ControlFlowShellCount) are asserted by tests/statement-possible/control-flow-body-takeover.mjs. The last group of cases is the DELIBERATELY UNCOVERED set (switch body, arrow block body, object method body, block-level function declaration, `if (a) b;`), which must stay on the legacy path: their readings are recorded in HANDOFF-s4n.md §5.

stage4n.stage: Stage 4n (control-flow body braces mounted with the block-body catalog)
stage4n.description: The eight canonical body forms (if / else / while / do-while / for / for-in / for-of / try-catch-finally / with), body contents (let / const / var / expression / await / nested block), nesting (control flow inside a body, control flow inside a function body, control flow inside a block), and the contrast/impostor group that must remain un-mounted.

cases.name: s4n-try-body
cases.source: try { d; } catch (e) { e; } finally { f; }

cases.name: s4n-else-if-chain
cases.source: if (a) { b; } else if (c) { d; } else { e; }

cases.name: s4n-body-await
cases.source: async function f() { if (a) { await g(); } }
